visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and straight bangs stands in a brightly lit indoor room. She points directly at the camera with her index finger, then shows five fingers while speaking enthusiastically. She wears a cream-colored top. (2) She holds up a small, clear plastic three-tier display case specifically designed for miniature items. The background shows wooden shelves and domestic decor. (3) A series of close-up shots feature her hands meticulously placing various miniature food models into the display case. These models include Chikawa-themed pancakes, desserts, and savory dishes on tiny plates. (4) The woman is seen using black scissors to carefully cut out character graphics and signage from a pink and purple cardboard box. (5) She attaches the cut-out paper decorations and stickers to the exterior of the clear display case to create a themed restaurant look. (6) The camera pans slowly over the completed display case, now filled with various Chikawa food toys and decorated with cardboard characters. A large ginger cat walks past the background behind the display.

(2) A sharp plastic 'clack' sounds as she presents the display case. (3) Rhythmic 'pop' sound effects play in sync with each miniature food item being placed inside the box, layered over the continuous BGM.
